18	/**
19	 * Derives the stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household, i.e. who share a
20	 * last name and postcode. The last name is normalized (case-insensitively, with collapsed
21	 * whitespace) and joined to the postcode with {@code '|'}; the identifier is the leading hex
22	 * characters of the SHA-256 digest of that pair. Because it is a deterministic digest, every owner
23	 * with the same last name and postcode computes the same value automatically, and it never changes
24	 * as members join or leave.
25	 */
26	public final class HouseholdIdGenerator {
27	
28	    /** Number of leading hex characters of the digest kept as the identifier. */
29	    private static final int LENGTH = 12;
30	
31	    private HouseholdIdGenerator() {
32	    }
33	
34	    /**
35	     * Produce the household identifier for the given last name and postcode, or {@code null} when
36	     * no postcode is on file (an owner without a postcode belongs to no shared household).
37	     *
38	     * @param lastName the household's last name
39	     * @param postcode the household's postcode
40	     * @return the identifier shared by every owner with this last name and postcode, or
41	     *         {@code null} when the postcode is absent
42	     */
43	    public static String generate(String lastName, String postcode) {
44	        if (postcode == null || postcode.isBlank()) {
45	            return null;
46	        }
47	        String key = TextNormalizer.normalizeForComparison(lastName) + '|' + postcode;
48	        return Sha256.hexPrefix(key, LENGTH);

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). Optional; when
            present it is prefixed to the owner's last name to form the
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and this value is returned as the composed address string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address,
            appended to 'addressLine1' in the composed address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid
            for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9()+\-.\s]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present, the owner's
            'ageBand' is derived from it against the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title followed by a space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title
                is on file.
              type: string
              example: DR Who
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the
                region derived from the owner's postcode, a hyphen, and HASH8 —
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the owner's
                normalized telephone concatenated with its last name. A stable
                identity derived from owner fields, with no sequence numbers.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3F2A9C1D
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the two-digit segment of the fiscal year of the
                registration date (a fiscal year starts on 1 July and is numbered
                by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: NSW-3F2A9C1D-M27
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The 'FY<YY>' label of the fiscal year the registration date falls
                in, where a fiscal year starts on 1 July and is numbered by the
                calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027
                is 'FY27'). Null when no registration date is on file.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a score derived from the owner's
                own fields: starting at 0, plus 2 when a contact email is on
                file, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes, plus 2 for a
                household of 3 or more, and plus 3 when the owner's tenure
                reaches one or more elapsed fiscal years.
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 mapped from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by every owner who knowingly shares a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F2A9C1D4B6E8071
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value used to detect duplicate owners, formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                Two owners are the same person only when their whole identity
                keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.com|3F2A9C1D4B6E8071'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the region component of the
                customer code, which was derived from the owner's postcode (and
                city) when the identity was assigned. Null when no customer code
                is assigned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone: the IANA name derived from the owner's
                locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane). Null when the locality is absent or has no
                known timezone.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed when this owner was
                created and share its first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on the
                current business day, signalling an unusually high signup volume;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, while not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode but has a different
                telephone; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                last name and postcode, different telephone), or null when there
                is no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the fields on
                file: 'EMAIL' when a contact email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band on the registration date, derived from
                'birthDate': 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR'
                (65 or older). Null when no birth date is on file.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained but flagged deleted and
                ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks. False
                for a newly created owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

              type: array

                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

## What I implemented

The identity key is now `SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName))`, and it's the single signal driving both duplicate (409) detection and the soft-match flag.

**New / changed code:**

1. **`util/Soundex.java`** (new) — standard 4-char American Soundex encoder (`"Smith"`/`"Smyth"` → `"S530"`), with vowel/`H`/`W` handling. Single responsibility, reused by both the identity key and the soft-match detector.

2. **`util/Sha256.java`** — added `hex(String)` returning the full 64-char **lower-case** digest (the existing `hexPrefix` stays upper-case for household id / customer code). Factored the digest step into a shared private helper so both methods reuse it.

3. **`model/Owner.getIdentityKey()`** — now returns `Sha256.hex(telephone + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + Soundex.encode(lastName))` instead of the old plaintext `telephone|email|householdId` join. `householdId` no longer participates in the key.

4. **`service/PossibleDuplicateDetector`** — the soft-match now fires when **identityKey differs** but **soundex(lastName) and postcode match** (previously: exact last name + postcode + different telephone). Because telephone is folded into the key, two owners with the same last name/postcode but different phones now surface here as a soft match rather than a hard 409.

5. **Duplicate detection** — `ClinicServiceImpl.isIdentityDuplicate` is unchanged in shape and remains the *single* duplicate check (409), still narrowing by telephone — valid since normalizedTelephone is part of the key — still ignoring `deleted` owners, and the controller still applies the email-domain blocklist first. There was no separate householdId-based 409 block to remove; the single identity-key check is now the only one.

6. **Docs** — updated the stale key-composition descriptions in `ClinicService`, `DuplicateIdentityException`, `ExceptionControllerAdvice`, and `openapi.yml` (`identityKey` description/example → 64-char lower-case digest).

The two acceptance checks — `identityKey` matching `[0-9a-f]{64}`, and an identical telephone/email/lastName copy returning 409 — both pass.
